title: Vital Conduit Boots
summary: Gain 8 temporary HP when casting a Concentration spell.

fields.Vital Conduit: Casting a Concentration spell grants 8 temporary HP. The source reports free recasts of spells such as Hex and Hunter’s Mark usually do not trigger it. Repositioning Cloudkill is a reported exception. Concentration cantrips qualify. Temporary HP does not stack with another source.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
